records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM order_items

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_ids FROM customers

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND order_date <= '2014-12-31'

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS items_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Consumer'

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS avg_discount_line,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.discount * oi.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.quantity > 0 THEN oi.quantity END), 0), 4) AS avg_discount_qty_weighted,
       COUNT(*) AS item_lines
FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY avg_discount_line DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 利润为负的亏损明细有多少行?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN profit = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN profit > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS profit_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN profit IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN profit < 0 THEN profit END), 2) AS loss_amount,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS loss_pct
FROM order_items

records.question: 运费最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和运费。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, shipping_cost FROM order_items ORDER BY shipping_cost DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 美国的客户有多少个?
records.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'United States') AS us_customers_total,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'United States') AS us_customers_with_orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) AS all_customers

records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt, COUNT(o.sales) AS non_null_sales, ROUND(AVG(o.sales), 2) AS avg_sales_per_row, ROUND(SUM(o.sales), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Technology'

records.question: 折扣不低于 0.3 的明细有多少行?

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?

FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region

records.question: 2013 年 3 月亚太市场有多少订单?

FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013','2014')
GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(i.profit)/SUM(i.sales)*100,2) AS margin_pct, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY margin_pct DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(oi.sales)  AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin,
       COUNT(*) AS items
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
       SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_per_order
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
  AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales, MAX(cnt) AS n
FROM r WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)

records.question: First Class 配送方式的平均运费是多少?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS avg_ship_cost_per_item,
       ROUND(MIN(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS min_cost,
       ROUND(MAX(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS max_cost
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

records.question: 剔除数量为 0 或负数、销售额为空的异常明细后,总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN quantity <= 0 OR sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS clean_sales,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS clean_rows
FROM order_items

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / SUM(i.sales) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_lines
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?

JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit), 2) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY avg_profit ASC

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
